hook: Same team. Too much to lose.
beat: A quarterback. A transfer center. One night that changes everything.

hook: Tutoring was supposed to be simple.

hook: His stepbrother moves in. There goes control.

hook: He's spent his life hearing 'too much'.

hook: His calm is completely off-limits.

hook: Chemistry is easy. Being seen is terrifying.

hook: Solve the mystery. Try not to fall.

hook: The captain's problem is now his roommate.

hook: He moved to save his marriage.

hook: Two single dads. One bluff called.

body: Sharing lifts for their sons becomes another beer, another excuse to stay. Then Adam calls Nick's bluff, and Nick kisses him back. Two single dads, double awakening and feelings that outgrow the joke.

hook: Wrong car. Best friend. Nowhere to hide.

body: Luke returns for a wedding. One disastrous night in the wrong luxury car leaves him and Miles looking involved in something dangerous. Old friendship returns with a very unfamiliar edge.

hook: His one-night stand is now his student.

hook: Everyone avoids him. Reed moves closer.
